Subject: SolaceGrid private deployment: network gating & delivery portal

Hi Alice / SolaceGrid IT,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. I wanted to capture the immediate networking and delivery items so we can align owners and dates. High-level asks:

- VPC peering: confirm CIDR ranges, desired cross-account peering model, and whether you prefer route-based or static routes.
- Private endpoints: list the subnets you want private endpoints in and the expected egress behavior.
- On-prem package: hardware checklist and preferred install window for the edge appliance (if applicable).
- KMS/HSM: whether you'll use your KMS or want Redwood-managed keys for token encryption at rest.

I've attached a first-pass network diagram and our provisioning checklist to make the triage easier. Proposed next steps:
1) Network review call the week of Jun 14 — please suggest two 1-hour windows.
2) SolaceGrid to confirm CIDRs + firewall egress policy by EOD Jun 13.
3) Redwood to prepare SOW draft and order form once we have CIDRs and target date.

Attachments: [Attachment: network-diagram-v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)], [Attachment: provisioning-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

If you want, Marcus can run a quick KV-cache/latency walk-through on the call so you see the tradeoffs for private endpoints vs tunneled egress.

Thanks — Priya

Priya — thanks, this is helpful.

Quick answers:
- We prefer route-based peering across accounts and will provide CIDRs by EOD Jun 13.
- Private endpoints: we'll place them in our app subnets (10.24.10.0/24 and 10.24.11.0/24). Expect NAT egress for third-party calls, but internal traffic should stay private.
- On-prem appliance: we are evaluating whether to run an appliance in our colocation. I'll confirm hardware and a tentative install week by Jun 18.
- KMS: we will use our KMS (AWS KMS) and need instructions for granting Redwood a limited key policy.

Can the network review call be Jun 15 between 09:00–11:00 PT? Marcus, Monica — will you be available then?
